captions.instagram:
A 3.4 metre ceiling in Bethnal Green. IKEA PAX with mirror doors below, MDF cupboards across the whole wall above, even over the door.

A level timber base went in first, then a 100 and a 50 cm PAX frame on it, then the cupboards, the same widths as the frames so every joint lines up.

My 22-page guide, IKEA PAX, built in, has the sums, the cut list and every step. Link in bio.
